resources.string: The report only includes the Firma Mobile version, its version code and the Android API level. It is not sent automatically, and no issue is created from the app.
No certificates, identifiers, documents, addresses or history are included. Copying places only the report shown on the clipboard.

github.com/zaguzovmaksim0-hue/workspace-47/issues/new will open with the previewed report in the URL. An issue is not created automatically: you will need to check and publish it on GitHub. GitHub will receive the visit and may associate it with your IP address or session. A published issue will be public. Do not add personal data, certificates, documents or private addresses.
Could not open GitHub. You can copy the report and open GitHub yourself.
